newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 71 OF MARCH 13, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 71 OF MARCH 13, 1997.
